_about: ACE Music v1 (the default model, 4 credits for two songs): ACE Music writes the style, lyrics and title from your idea
prompt: A late-night neo-soul slow jam about two strangers sharing an umbrella at a bus stop in the rain and missing the last bus on purpose. Warm Rhodes piano, brushed drums, round upright bass, a smoky female lead with close three-part harmonies on the chorus.

_about: ACE Music v1.1 Preview (4 credits): writes a score first, then the audio
prompt: An anthemic Celtic folk-rock singalong about a fishing crew racing a storm back to the harbor. Fiddle and tin whistle hooks, stomping kick drum, bodhran, a gravelly male lead and the whole crew shouting the chorus.

_about: ACE-Step v1.5 XL (no credits on any ACE Music plan, the Free plan included)
prompt: A breezy bossa nova for a lazy Sunday afternoon in Lisbon: nylon-string guitar, soft brushed snare, upright bass, a gentle flute line and a warm male and female duet sung in Portuguese.
